summary: Use the commutator τ = [g₀, γ] ∈ H, at which y has a unit coordinate. Isotropy on zH and equivariance show that each x_w(cτ) vanishes on the image of multiplication by α − χ(cg)α' (applied to the vectors A·y(τ), which span all of (O/I)^n), so x_w(cτ) factors through the cokernel; w ↦ x_w(cτ) is injective, and the dual of the cokernel has the size of the torsion.
